_readme: ONE place for every name, icon, status, store link, domain and email on the site. Edit, then run `node tools/build.mjs` and commit the regenerated public/ folder. {name}, {nameHi}, {package}, {studio}, {email}, {domain}, {host} in text are filled in by the build.

p: {name} shows Google AdMob ads in two formats only: rewarded video ads and banner ads. A rewarded ad never plays by itself: it starts only after you tap a button that shows an ad icon and names the reward, and there is a daily limit. A banner sits at the bottom of the game screen in matches against the computer. There is no banner in Pass and Play. There are no interstitial ads or other full-screen ads between games.

AdMob may collect and use the advertising ID, device and app information, approximate location from the IP address, ad interactions, and its own diagnostics, to serve, personalise, measure and limit ads, and to prevent fraud. Ads can be personalised using the advertising ID, depending on your consent choices. See how Google uses information from apps that use its services. You can reset or delete the advertising ID in your phone's settings (Google, then Ads).

If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), the UK or Switzerland, the app asks for your consent through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) before it requests ads, and your choice decides whether ads can be personalised. You can change your choice at any time in Account, then Settings, then Privacy choices. This entry appears when Google's consent rules apply to you.

Google Play builds of {name} include Google Firebase Analytics. It records four kinds of play event: a screen being opened (the screen's name), a game starting (the game mode and the number of players), a game ending (the winning seat, such as red human or yellow computer, and the match length in seconds), and a reward being claimed (the reward type and the coins in that reward).

Firebase sends these events with an app-instance ID, the advertising ID, and basic device and app information such as the phone model, Android version, app version and approximate location from the IP address. Your name, photo, gender, friends' names and coin balance are not sent.

Google keeps this event data for the retention period set in our Firebase project, and then deletes it. Uninstalling the app or clearing its storage removes the app-instance ID from the phone, and you can reset or delete the advertising ID in your phone's settings (Google, then Ads). See Google's privacy policy and how Google uses information from apps that use its services.

To check the India date (Asia/Kolkata) for daily rewards, and to stop rewards and ad limits being reset by changing the phone's clock, the Android app sends an HTTPS HEAD request, with no body, to https://www.google.com/generate_204 and reads only the Date header of the reply. The request carries no game data, no player details and no advertising or device ID. Like any web request, it lets Google see the phone's IP address. If the phone is offline, the app uses its own clock checks.

Reminders are off until you turn them on in Account and allow notifications. The app then schedules at most one local reminder a day, around 7 pm phone time, and only while you are away from the game. The reminder is made and shown on this phone. Nothing is sent to a push server. You can turn reminders off in the app at any time.

Play vs AI is played against computer opponents on the phone, and each one is labelled AI. Choosing a photo opens the system picker. The app does not ask for camera or photo library permission. Vibration only runs when that setting is on. The share button opens your phone's share sheet. The app does not receive the list of people you share with.

p: {name} shows Google AdMob ads in two formats only: rewarded video ads and banner ads. A rewarded ad never plays by itself: it starts only after you tap a button that shows an ad icon and names the reward, and there is a daily limit. A banner is shown at the bottom of the puzzle screen. There are no interstitial ads or other full-screen ads between games.

AdMob may collect and use the advertising ID, device and app information, approximate location from the IP address, ad interactions, and its own diagnostics, to serve, personalise, measure and limit ads, and to prevent fraud. Ads can be personalised using the advertising ID, depending on your consent choices. See how Google uses information from apps that use its services. You can reset or delete the advertising ID in your phone's settings (Google, then Ads).

If you are in the European Economic Area (EEA), the UK or Switzerland, the app asks for your consent through Google's User Messaging Platform (UMP) before it requests ads, and your choice decides whether ads can be personalised. You can change your choice at any time in Profile, then Settings, then Privacy choices. This entry appears when Google's consent rules apply to you.
AdMob is the only third party that receives data from this app. {name} does not include Firebase or any other analytics service.

To stop daily rewards and ad limits being reset by changing the phone's clock, the Android app sends an HTTPS HEAD request, with no body, to https://www.google.com/generate_204 and reads only the Date header of the reply. The request carries no game data, no player details and no advertising or device ID. Like any web request, it lets Google see the phone's IP address. If the phone is offline, the app uses its own clock checks.
{name} does not schedule or show notifications.

The share button passes a short line about your result (your chosen name, the level and your time) to your phone's share options, or copies it if sharing is not available. It leaves the phone only if you then send it. Vibration only runs when that setting is on.

footAbout.hi: एक छोटा स्टूडियो। Google Play के लिए गेम। सिक्के सिर्फ़ खेलने के लिए हैं, उनका कोई पैसा मूल्य नहीं है।

coinsNote.en: Coins are earned only, for play, and have no money value. They cannot be bought or cashed out. Package name: {package}.
coinsNote.hi: सिक्के सिर्फ़ खेलकर कमाए जाते हैं और उनका कोई पैसा मूल्य नहीं है। इन्हें न ख़रीदा जा सकता है न भुनाया जा सकता है। पैकेज नाम: {package}.

legalEnOnly.hi: यह पेज अभी केवल अंग्रेज़ी में है। हिंदी अनुवाद जल्द आएगा।

notFoundBody.en: The page you asked for is not here. It may have moved, or the link may be mistyped.
notFoundBody.hi: आप जो पेज ढूँढ रहे हैं वह यहाँ नहीं है। शायद यह कहीं और चला गया है, या लिंक में कोई गलती है।

notFoundBack.en: Go back to the Bharat Joy home
notFoundBack.hi: भारत जॉय होम पर वापस जाएँ

contactLead.en: For help with a game, a question about your data, or anything else, write to us. We read every message and reply in English or Hindi.
contactLead.hi: किसी गेम में मदद, अपने डेटा के बारे में सवाल, या कुछ और, हमें लिखें। हम हर संदेश पढ़ते हैं और अंग्रेज़ी या हिंदी में जवाब देते हैं।

contactTips.en: To help us help you, please mention the game name, your phone model and Android version, and what happened.
contactTips.hi: जल्दी मदद के लिए, कृपया गेम का नाम, अपने फ़ोन का मॉडल और Android वर्शन, और क्या हुआ, यह लिखें।

contactNoAccount.en: Our games have no online account, so we never need your password and will never ask for one.
contactNoAccount.hi: हमारे गेम में कोई ऑनलाइन खाता नहीं है, इसलिए हमें आपके पासवर्ड की ज़रूरत नहीं है और हम कभी नहीं माँगेंगे।
